review_locator: PMID:20451555, ATP in neuron-glia bidirectional signalling, astrocyte purinergic signaling section
primary_title: ATP induces leukemia inhibitory factor mRNA in cultured rat astrocytes
decision_basis: The neuron-glia ATP review identifies purinergic ATP signaling as a regulator of glial communication; the cited primary reports intense ATP-induced LIF mRNA expression in cultured rat astrocytes and implicates P2Y2/P2Y4 receptors.
limitations_preserved: ATP induced LIF mRNA in cultured rat astrocytes; preserve the measured transcript output separately from LIF protein release and avoid an unmeasured transcription-to-secretion inference.

primary_title: Activity-dependent neuron-glial signaling by ATP and leukemia-inhibitory factor promotes hippocampal glial cell development
decision_basis: The neuron-glia ATP review nominates ATP-mediated neuron-glia communication; the cited primary directly measured increased LIF in conditioned medium from primary mouse hippocampal astrocytes after ATPgammaS stimulation.
limitations_preserved: ATPgammaS increased measured LIF protein release from primary mouse hippocampal astrocytes; preserve the conditioned-medium protein assay and agonist-specific context without asserting a direct ATPgammaS-to-LIF molecular interaction.
